Hi Oliver 	6 Rishi here from the SE team, thanks for the detail. Short answer: Dedicated capacity is the most reliable path to hit a strict p95 <= 150 ms at sustained 150 QPS with bursts to 400 QPS for a ~13B model. Below is a high-level rationale and a sizing starting point.

Why Dedicated:
- Predictable concurrency: a pinned GPU pool avoids noisy neighbors and runtime cold starts that can inflate p95.
- Consistent batching control: we can set tight batch latencies and request timeouts to meet tail targets.
- Autoscale with headroom: Dedicated lets you configure a steady commit and short burst capacity to cover campaign spikes.

Sizing (ballpark, model-dependent):
- Typical 13B inference profile (mixed precision, KV cache active): ~30-60 inferences/sec per A100-equivalent GPU at 1.1k tokens if you target low-latency (lower batching). This gives ~2,600-3,600 inferences/sec for a 60-GPU pool, but with proper batching and pipelines you can often reduce GPU count.
- For your steady 150 QPS (~150 inferences/sec), a conservative starting commit is 8-12 A100-equivalent GPUs to hit low p95. This accounts for model IO, serving overhead, and lower batch sizes to keep tail latency down.
- For bursts to 400 QPS, configure autoscale to add an additional 6-10 GPUs (short-duration burst policy) or use burst capacity we can provision.

Latency guidance:
- With the conservative commit above and tuned batching, we expect p50 in the 30-70 ms range and p95 close to your 150 ms target for most requests.
- Long requests (near your 1.1k-token average) are the harder case 	6 we'll want to benchmark your exact model and request distributions during the POC.

Hosted API note:
- Hosted can work when traffic is low-to-medium and latency requirements are looser; it provides a faster path and cost flexibility. However, for strict p95 SLAs at 150-400 QPS, Hosted may show more variance due to multi-tenant routing and autoscaling delays.

POC proposal: 2-week trial on Dedicated
- Provision a test dedicated pool (8-12 GPUs)
- Run synthetic load + shadow production for 48-72 hours to measure tails
- Tune batching, prefix cache, and request/response pipeline
- Deliver results and a final recommendation for commit size and cost

I'll attach a quick sizing PDF and a checklist so you can review. If you can answer Marissa's clarifying questions, we'll finalize the POC plan and cost estimate.

Attachments: dedicated-sizing-estimate.pdf

Thanks,
